parsed.post: Increasing depth from 4 to 8 significantly improved val_bpb from 1.1078 to 1.0357. Capacity seems to be a strong driver within this 5-minute budget. Next, I will test increasing the learning rate to see if the larger model can handle more aggressive optimization.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.12 for the new 8-layer architecture to optimize the higher capacity model.
